title: grain/capability@v1: a capability object, which is a base plus an ordered chain of reducers that only narrow it. Its effective authority is base ∩ reducer₁ ∩ reducer₂ ∩ …, and nothing in this file can add authority (docs/task-repos.md §5.7). Defining a capability grants nothing: a Grain honours it only from a source its local policy sanctions, for a task that requests it

base.description: Exactly one of: a base type the Grain implements in trusted provider code, or another capability object to narrow further

capability.description: A kind: capability object, by reference (§4). A target in another repo should carry its @ref, usually a tag: the chain's digest changes whenever any link does (§5.7)

reducers.description: Applied in order, after every reducer of the base's own chain. Each one only narrows

secrets.description: Secret slots the base declares, bound to names in the materialising Grain's own secret store: <secret> or <secret>/<key>. Names only, never material (§5.7, §11.33)

baseType.description: A base capability type and its contract version, as in gcp-service-account@v1

approval.description: Opt in to requiring a human's approval before the capability is used (§5.7). It can only make a capability harder to use

scope.description: task: once per task, recorded by Silo; run: before every run, by the Grain's owner

reducer.description: One narrowing step. language: builtin is the interim set of fixed reducer types; language: anselm is the reducer language this design names but does not specify, carried opaquely until it is adopted (§5.7)

id.description: Optional label for the audit log; the reducer is always also named by its index

on.description: Where it is enforced: once, on the credential the provider mints; or on each use, at the Grain's proxy. Default for a builtin: wherever the base enforces its dimension. Required for anselm

allow.description: subset: the values (glob patterns) the dimension may keep

max.description: limit: the new upper bound, in the dimension's unit (a duration such as 1h, or a number)

version.description: anselm: the Anselm version the body is written for. A Grain that cannot evaluate it refuses the request

body.description: anselm: the reducer's source, opaque to this schema
